messages:
pagerduty-bot: Incident: HIGH - EmberLink org 9384 throttle spike detected on hosted inference. Alerts: 5xx ratio ↑ 12% over 3m, avg latency ↑ 2x. Pager: sanjay (oncall)

sanjay (oncall): on it. joining call in 2. link?

Nina (sre): recorded similar pattern — org-scoped rate limiter firing hard, queues growing on inference-proxy. Looks like a new customer rollout causing burst.

Alexa (eng-runtime): EmberLink is hitting sustained QPS bursts with long prompt lengths. Current org quota: 30 qps, they're spiking to ~160 qps. Runtime logs show backpressure and soft-fail path to 429.

Marcus (support): customer-facing — EmberLink reports degraded UX, some users seeing timeouts. They want a fast temporary fix while they throttle at their side.

sanjay (oncall): suggested mitigations: 1) short-term org QPS bump 30->80 for 30m 2) apply token-based rate smoothing 3) if that fails, force-fallback to smaller model for that org. Thoughts?

Nina (sre): agree. safety checks: need to ensure bump won't starve other orgs on shared pool. Check pool headroom now.

ops-bot: Pool headroom check: hosted-pool-2 GPUs available: 4/8 free. Active weighted util: 64%. Estimated safe org bump to 80qps for 30m: OK.

Alexa (eng-runtime): quick command to apply soft bump (no billing change):

```
# CLI to apply org-scoped temporary quota (no commit)
rctl org modify --org-id=9384 --quota-qps=80 --quota-duration=30m --note="incident temporary bump by SRE"
```

sanjay (oncall): running the command now. will post output.

[COMMAND OUTPUT]
ops-bot: Executing: rctl org modify --org-id=9384 --quota-qps=80 --quota-duration=30m --note="incident temporary bump by SRE"
ops-bot: Success: org 9384 quota updated. Effective in 6s. Audit id: audit_20237_9

Nina (sre): seeing throttles drop immediately. 429s down from 18%->4% in 30s. Latency trending down.

Marcus (support): I notified EmberLink account team: "We applied a 30-minute temporary smoothing bump to mitigate degraded UX; we'll follow up with recommended client-side throttling and gradual ramp plan." They replied: "Thanks, saw immediate improvement — please keep us posted."

sanjay (oncall): schedule: set alarm to re-evaluate at t+20m and auto-expire at t+30m. Also create follow-up for capacity/plan.

Alexa (eng-runtime): created a canary route to force smaller model on heavy sessions if token latency > 2s, as fallback. Command: `rctl route update --org=9384 --fallback-model=gpt-small --threshold-latency=2000ms`

Nina (sre): adding a temporary traffic-shaper rule to smooth spikes from EmberLink sessions (per-token burst window).

```
# traffic-shaper rule snippet
shaper apply --org 9384 --burst=150 --sustain=60 --strategy=leaky_bucket --duration=30m
```

ops-bot: Shaper applied.

sanjay (oncall): monitoring. Also flagged billing team: temporary bump may affect short-term units; set expectation with CS. Marcus noted customer approved.

Nina (sre): notes for postmortem: root cause likely client-side release sending fanout of long prompts. Action items: 1) ask EmberLink for rollout throttle 2) recommend client batching/windowing 3) capacity eval for org at +100qps 4) ensure org bump workflow logs include SLA impact and approval chain.

Marcus (support): creating ticket ENG-PLAT-4821 to track follow-up and document customer-approved mitigation. Including screenshots and audit id.

sanjay (oncall): t+20m check — metrics look stable, 5xx back to baseline, no queue growth. If EmberLink requests extension, they must provide mitigation plan.

EmberLink (via Marcus): "We plan to roll a server-side limiter and will request a gradual quota increase over next week."

Nina (sre): will let the temporary bump expire at +30m. If they need extension, require CS approval and capacity evaluation. I'll capture logs and attach to ticket.

ops-bot: Temporary quota for org 9384 will auto-expire at 2376545010 (30m).

sanjay (oncall): closing loop — mitigated, monitoring. Filing brief incident note and assigning post-incident follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Incident reference: INC-20237-9384.

Nina (sre): postmortem stub: EmberLink surge -> org-level RL bled into high 429s -> temporary org bump + shaper + fallback model -> mitigated. Will expand with timeline and client-side recommendations.

Marcus (support): I'll send EmberLink the mitigation summary and next steps before EOD.

sanjay (oncall): great. handing off to Nina for postmortem and to Marcus for CS comms. Follow-ups assigned.
